text: nice this is good. so can you give a tool that lets me draw out like a straight line for example and that turns into a line of walls, or for floor, i can cover a rectangle of space, and it does a floor
resolution: Added drag-to-build in the iso pane. With a WALL armed, dragging paints a straight line of walls along the drag's dominant axis (yaw 0 along x / 90 along z); with a FLOOR armed, dragging fills the swept rectangle with floor tiles. A live translucent ghost previews every piece (blocked-red where the validator refuses it) and the whole run commits as ONE batch (one undo step, one store snapshot via commitMany). The cell math mirrors resolveSnapTarget's conventions exactly — 3m module pitch, floors on cell centres, walls run-centred on cells and line-snapped to the 3m edges — so drag-placed pieces land identically to click-placed ones; all cells share a single terrain-pad base y so the run reads flat and matches the post-placement liftToTerrain. Capped at 64 cells/axis so a huge drag can't spawn thousands of pieces. Click still single-places, and drag still rotates the camera for non-wall/floor tools and when nothing is armed. Hint text shows 'drag = wall line / floor area' for the armed kind. Committed e7374e10a, bundles clean.
